full_details: In the morning you wrote one sentence to Anne and did not send it. You do not yet know the day. You will not write a yes to be rid of the question. Nothing went to the Bell. At two you played Two Gentlemen of Verona. The Rose bill was Grecian Comedy. You did not go. After the play the sharers set the week: Titus on Monday, not you; the Shrew on Tuesday, you, and the reading at Dick's with no roll in a hand; the old Hamlet on Wednesday, you; Errors on Thursday, you, with a rehearsal at nine; the Shrew on Friday, not you; Errors on Saturday, you. No share was named. The coffer was not counted. Supper tomorrow is at the Burbages'. The letter is still unsent.
one_sentence: You played Two Gentlemen at two, and at the reckoning you set next week's book.
title: Played Two Gentlemen and set next week
